create_jwt_access_token: create a JWT access token for a user with a configurable expiry and token version
decode_and_validate_jwt_token: decode and validate a JWT token returning TokenPayload or a specific TokenError variant
create_token_with_custom_expiry: create a JWT access token with a custom timedelta expiry instead of the default
review_token_payload_model: review the TokenPayload pydantic model with fields sub, exp, iat, and ver
handle_expired_jwt_token: handle an expired JWT token by returning TokenError.EXPIRED from decode_token
